QUOTE: It calls `client.createPost` again with a new request. ... On failure it sets `failed` back to true, or removes the post for the same three server errors listed above.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retryFailedPost makes a single new createPost call and on failure re-marks the post failed or removes it for the same three errors. It also says automatic retries are zero, so no loop or backoff is implied.
